eligibility_note: Panel GMM/IV-Tobit, 43 SSA economies, ICT exposure, financial inclusion outcome (family 5); meets the 10-economy rule.

risk_of_bias.confounding_reverse_causation: agree: regressors treated as exogenous with causal language; reverse causality not credibly handled.
risk_of_bias.exposure_measurement: agree: standard WDI subscription counts, composite construction vague.
risk_of_bias.selection_of_countries_years: agree: data-availability sample, effective N 28-37 countries.
risk_of_bias.outcome_measurement: too_harsh: bank accounts, branches and ATMs are conventional supply-side access proxies, so moderate fits better than serious.
risk_of_bias.specification: agree: lagged DV coefficients at or above 1 (1.003 to 1.050) and marginal AR2 in Table 7 are valid concerns.
risk_of_bias.selective_reporting: agree: credit, deposits and loans outcomes are mentioned but not tabulated.
risk_of_bias.why: Overall serious holds because exogeneity is assumed and causal claims are made.

problems: none; minor: Table 5 col 2 internet SE (0.00235) differs from Table 2 (0.00368), which is correct because they are different estimators.
